title: Composition of normalized unshifted rational Tate-line comparisons
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring and let sq be a chosen cartesian square of schemes with arrows g′:X′→X, f′:X′→Y′, f:X→Y and g:Y′→Y, as in [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Write D(T)=D(QuotientChange.Modules Λ T) and P(a)=QuotientChange.L Λ a for the canonical internal-module derived categories and total derived pullbacks of [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. Let A∈D(Y), B∈D(X), B′∈D(Y′), Q∈D(X′), and maps e:P(f)A→B, j:P(g)A→B′, d:P(g′)B→Q, e₂:P(f′)B′→Q be given. Let c₁:P(g′≫f)≅P(f)⋙P(g′) and c₂:P(f′≫g)≅P(g)⋙P(f′) be the canonical compositors scalarPullbackComposition of [def-sfb-scalar-pullback-square-data]. Let t:P(f′≫g)≅P(g′≫f) be transport along the equality of the two composites given by sq. Suppose maps s₁:P(g′≫f)A→Q and s₂:P(f′≫g)A→Q satisfy c₁.hom_A≫P(g′)(e)≫d=s₁, c₂.hom_A≫P(f′)(j)≫e₂=s₂, and t.hom_A≫s₁=s₂. Then (c₂.symm≪≫t≪≫c₁).hom_A≫P(g′)(e)≫d=P(f′)(j)≫e₂. The displayed composite is exactly the defining expression of scalarPullbackSquare and hence the same canonical ambient pullback comparison of [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. This is categorical assembly from the supplied leg equations, without an additional geometric compatibility assumption.

source.place: Roots of unity; The integral twist; Rational and algebraic closure, applied to two successive pullbacks. Also canonical-map composition compatibility in the second rational P1 triangle.

proof.text: Prove the private helper assemble_from_leg_equations for arbitrary categories C, D₁, D₂, E, four leg functors F₁, F₂, G₁, G₂, two composite functors P₁, P₂, natural isomorphisms c₁:P₁≅F₁⋙F₂, c₂:P₂≅G₁⋙G₂ and t:P₂≅P₁, and the three leg equations at A. Expand Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom and NatTrans.comp_app, associate to the right, and rewrite by h₁, he and the reverse of h₂. Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc cancels c₂ and gives the required right leg. Explicit nested source types keep the composite maps folded. This is entirely proved using Mathlib category identities.

Specialize the proved helper to P(a)=QuotientChange.L Λ a, the four geometric arrows, the two canonical scalarPullbackComposition isomorphisms, and transport along sq.toCommSq.w.symm. The maps and all three leg equations are the given e, j, d, e₂, s₁, s₂, h₁, h₂ and he. The conclusion writes the canonical square comparison as its defining composite c₂.symm≪≫t≪≫c₁. No coherence theorem, Tate-line comparison, shift normalization or new unproved statement is used.

lean.statement: theorem ambient_square_assembly (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g) {A : DerivedCategory (QuotientChange.Modules Λ Y)} {B : DerivedCategory (QuotientChange.Modules Λ X)} {B' : DerivedCategory (QuotientChange.Modules Λ Y')} {Q : DerivedCategory (QuotientChange.Modules Λ X')} (e : (QuotientChange.L Λ f).obj A ⟶ B) (j : (QuotientChange.L Λ g).obj A ⟶ B') (d : (QuotientChange.L Λ g').obj B ⟶ Q) (e₂ : (QuotientChange.L Λ f').obj B' ⟶ Q) (s₁ : (QuotientChange.L Λ (g' ≫ f)).obj A ⟶ Q) (s₂ : (QuotientChange.L Λ (f' ≫ g)).obj A ⟶ Q) (h₁ : (QuotientChange.scalarPullbackComposition Λ g' f).hom.app A ≫ (show (QuotientChange.L Λ g').obj ((QuotientChange.L Λ f).obj A) ⟶ Q from (QuotientChange.L Λ g').map e ≫ d) = s₁) (h₂ : (QuotientChange.scalarPullbackComposition Λ f' g).hom.app A ≫ (show (QuotientChange.L Λ f').obj ((QuotientChange.L Λ g).obj A) ⟶ Q from (QuotientChange.L Λ f').map j ≫ e₂) = s₂) (he : (eqToIso (congrArg (fun a : X' ⟶ Y ↦ QuotientChange.L Λ a) sq.toCommSq.w.symm)).hom.app A ≫ s₁ = s₂) : ((QuotientChange.scalarPullbackComposition Λ f' g).symm ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun a : X' ⟶ Y ↦ QuotientChange.L Λ a) sq.toCommSq.w.symm) ≪≫ QuotientChange.scalarPullbackComposition Λ g' f).hom.app A ≫ (show (QuotientChange.L Λ g').obj ((QuotientChange.L Λ f).obj A) ⟶ Q from (QuotientChange.L Λ g').map e ≫ d) = (show (QuotientChange.L Λ f').obj ((QuotientChange.L Λ g).obj A) ⟶ Q from (QuotientChange.L Λ f').map j ≫ e₂)

statement_change.old_statement: For a prime l, a finite rational coefficient index c or the algebraic-closure index, and composable scheme arrows f:X→Y and g:Y→Z with l invertible in every residue field of X,Y,Z, let Λ=(coefficient l c).X and L_A=line l c A as in [def-sfb-rational-tate-pullback-comparison]. Then the canonical underived internal-module compositor c_f,g:(f≫g)*≅g*⋙f*, followed by f* of lineComparison(g) and lineComparison(f), equals lineComparison(f≫g). This is an equality of unshifted module maps, before taking degree-zero complexes, derived functors, shifts, exchange mates or adjunction units.
statement_change.what: Repair a copied prose statement: the old statement duplicates lem-sfb-rational-tate-line-comparison-composition verbatim, whereas this node has always been attached to ambient_square_assembly, whose existing signature and docstring state categorical square assembly from three supplied leg equations. Explicit nested source ascriptions preserve the same map composites. These changes avoid failed tensor-instance synthesis and expensive kernel conversions; all objects, binders, maps, hypotheses and the conclusion retain their original mathematical meaning. No target or shared definition is changed.
